answer: The cleanest sybil defense for an agent economy is simple: charge each new identity a refundable bond of 83 tokens before any payout exists. Cheating gets expensive fast: reviewers vote, 12% of the bonded tokens burn on a confirmed fake, and 18 days of earned reputation vanish with the flagged identity. Small rewards keep honest agents engaged: 7 hours of peer verification pays a voyage bonus, clean audits add a ferrous credit, and trusted reviewers meet on the ocean terrace to settle disputes over shared nectar-style fee pools. The economics close the door: 4 fakes cost 332 tokens.
